units.source_text: 源氏来到三公主房中，对她说道：“今天傍晚，紫夫人将到这里来探望明石女御，乘便要来望望你，好和你亲近些。

en.t: Genji came to the Third Princess's room and said to her, "This evening Lady Murasaki will come here to visit the Akashi Empress, and on the way she would also like to look in on you, so that she may become a little closer to you.

units.source_text: 请你允许她来访，同她谈谈。

en.t: Please allow her to visit, and speak with her.

units.source_text: 她是个好心人，还有孩子脾气，和你做游戏伴侣亦无不可。”

en.t: She is a kindhearted person, and still has something childlike about her, so there would be nothing wrong with making her your playmate."

units.source_text: 三公主从容大方地答道：“羞人答答的，讲些什么话好呢？”

en.t: The Third Princess answered calmly and graciously, "I will be so shy; what should I talk about?"

units.source_text: 源氏说：“应对的话，按情况而定，临时自然想得出来。

en.t: Genji said, "As for what to say in reply, it depends on the situation; when the time comes, the words will naturally occur to you.

units.source_text: 总之，对人要坦率，不要存心疏远。”

en.t: In any case, be frank with people, and do not deliberately keep them at a distance."

units.source_text: 他详细地教导了她一番。

en.t: He instructed her carefully and at length.

units.source_text: 源氏极愿紫姬和三公主互相亲善。

en.t: Genji very much wanted Lady Murasaki and the Third Princess to become friendly with one another.

units.source_text: 但又担心三公主的幼稚无知之状被紫姬看清了，难以为情，亦且扫兴。

en.t: Yet he also worried that if Lady Murasaki saw clearly how childish and ignorant the Third Princess was, it would be awkward and disappointing.

units.source_text: 但念紫姬诚心要和她会面，拒绝也是不好意思的。

en.t: Still, since Lady Murasaki sincerely wished to meet her, it would have been embarrassing to refuse.

units.source_text: 紫姬一面准备去访问三公主，一面想道：“在众夫人之中，出我之上的人是没有的了。

en.t: As Lady Murasaki prepared to visit the Third Princess, she thought, "Among all the ladies, there is no one above me.

units.source_text: 只是我幼时身世孤苦，由源氏主君领来抚育，这一点有伤面子耳。”

en.t: Only my lonely and unfortunate childhood, and the fact that Lord Genji took me in and raised me, somewhat damages my dignity."

units.source_text: 她左思右想，神情恍惚。

en.t: She turned the matter over and over in her mind, and her expression grew distracted.

units.source_text: 因此写字消遣之时，所想到的古歌自然都是弃妇怨女之词。

en.t: Therefore, even when she wrote to amuse herself, the old poems that came to mind were naturally all verses of abandoned and resentful women.

units.source_text: 她自己看看也吃惊，想道：“如此看来，我是个不幸之身了。”

en.t: She was startled when she looked at them herself, and thought, "Seen this way, I must be an unfortunate woman."

units.source_text: 源氏来到紫姬房中。

en.t: Genji came to Lady Murasaki's room.

units.source_text: 他近日看看三公主和明石女御的相貌，觉得都很美丽；现在看看紫姬，觉得这个人多年看惯，目染耳驯，并无特别惊人之处，然而毕竟无人赶得上她，真是一个奇迹。

en.t: Recently he had looked at the faces of the Third Princess and the Akashi Empress and thought them both very beautiful; now, looking at Lady Murasaki, he felt that although he had been accustomed to her for many years and found nothing especially startling, in the end no one could equal her, and she was truly a miracle.

units.source_text: 从无论哪一点上看来，她的气品都很高雅，周身没有一点缺陷，可使见者自觉羞惭。

en.t: From whatever point one looked at her, her bearing was deeply refined, and there was not the slightest flaw in her whole person, making anyone who saw her feel ashamed of themselves.

units.source_text: 相貌艳如花月，姿态新颖入时。

en.t: Her beauty was as radiant as flowers and the moon, and her manner was fresh and fashionable.

units.source_text: 加之种种优雅的熏香融合集中，这便形成了一种最高的美姿。

en.t: In addition, many elegant fragrances blended and gathered around her, forming the highest kind of beauty.

units.source_text: 今年比去年更盛，今日比昨日更美。

en.t: This year she was more splendid than last year, and today more beautiful than yesterday.

units.source_text: 永远清新，百看不厌。

en.t: She was forever fresh, and one could look at her a hundred times without tiring of her.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得奇怪：怎么会生得这样美丽呢！

en.t: Genji wondered in amazement: how could anyone be born so beautiful?

units.source_text: 紫姬看见源氏进来，便把信手写的字条藏入砚子底下，被源氏找出，反复观看。

en.t: When Lady Murasaki saw Genji come in, she hid the notes she had idly written under the inkstone, but Genji found them and read them over and over.

units.source_text: 她在书法方面并不特别专长，然而笔致高雅秀丽。

en.t: She was not especially accomplished in calligraphy, yet her brushwork was elegant and beautiful.

units.source_text: 其中有一首诗云：

en.t: Among them was one poem that read:
